status: Retrospective analysis of the reported cohorts; comparisons and methods fixed before computing the new tests, after the descriptive results were known.
multiplicity: Holm correction separately within the four listed families; every listed comparison is reported.

bootstrap.method: Independently resample complete training-seed rows and seller-seed columns, retaining both costs together. Resample each shared seller-seed column jointly across PPO and the fixed/clipped comparator; independently resample the selected random policy's separate seller-seed cohort.
bootstrap.standard_error: Sample standard deviation of the bootstrap differences.
bootstrap.confidence_interval: Unadjusted 95 percent basic bootstrap interval, supplied in the machine-readable output.

MSPM.contrast: Best exactly evaluated welfare within the reported budget minus exact optimal SPM welfare, separately for types 2 through 6.
MSPM.unit: 25 independent training runs per type, seeds 96 through 120; best-checkpoint selection remains part of the reported estimand.
MSPM.test: Exact sign test of equally probable positive and negative seed-level gaps, conditional on a nonzero gap; numerical ties within zero_tolerance are omitted only from the sign count, not from effect estimates.
MSPM.endpoint: Maximum over 51 scheduled evaluations and the separate final greedy evaluation, exactly matching the manuscript welfare table.

Platform.contrast: Mean final PPO consumer surplus minus each validation-selected fixed comparator or the frozen random-search winner, averaging the two costs equally.
Platform.unit: 25 independent PPO training seeds crossed with 25 shared confirmation seller seeds; the selected random policy uses 25 different confirmation seller seeds.
Platform.test: Centered crossed bootstrap of the mean difference, using the bootstrap settings above.
Platform.scope: Conditional on the frozen comparator policies. The single random-search run does not estimate variability across random-search training runs.

Atari.contrast: Seller-led minus buyer-led terminal accepted price, seller payoff, and buyer payoff.
Atari.unit: 25 independent training-seed policy means per role, conditional on the shared upstream checkpoints and fixed 20-episode evaluation cohort.
Atari.test: Welch unequal-variance two-sample t-test, retaining the existing analysis.
Atari.endpoint: Final scheduled evaluation, with no testing at intermediate training checkpoints.

Ablations.contrast: Full minus gameplay-only response credit; phase-visible minus phase-hidden at each of the two shared learning rates; response-reward exclusion minus inclusion for each coordination game.
Ablations.unit: 25 matched training seeds for each comparison, averaging evaluation episodes within each trained policy.
Ablations.test: Exact paired sign test of equally probable positive and negative within-seed differences, conditional on a nonzero difference. This handles discrete and constant differences without a zero-variance t-test.
Ablations.endpoint: Final update for response credit; final fresh 100-episode policy evaluations for both matrix ablations.
